statusReason: The fresh frozen acceptance run and all manual SC-5–SC-8 checks passed, and build, race-enabled tests, lint, E2E, and the dedicated wraparound test passed. The mandatory make vuln gate failed with three reachable vulnerabilities. The same three findings reproduce on master, so this is not a feature regression, but AC-32 still fails and Gate 3 is not opened.

findings.title: Baseline dependencies/toolchain fail the mandatory vulnerability gate
findings.expected: make vuln exits successfully with no reachable vulnerabilities.
findings.actual: govulncheck reports reachable GO-2026-6809 in crypto/x509@go1.25.13, GO-2026-6629 in golang.org/x/text@v0.39.0 and GO-2026-6607 in crypto/tls@go1.25.13. Fixes are identified as go1.26.10, x/text v0.41.0 and go1.26.9 respectively. Master produces the same three findings, so the feature diff did not introduce them.
findings.reproduction: PATH=$(go env GOPATH)/bin:$PATH make vuln; compare logs/working/qa-018/make-vuln.log and logs/working/qa-018/make-vuln-master.log. This remains a failed required criterion despite its baseline origin.

findings.title: Existing fixture preparation emits a harmless command-not-found diagnostic
findings.expected: Fixture preparation has no shell diagnostic.
findings.actual: prepare-test-environment.sh line 36 reports 'all: command not found' once per cluster, after which PG14–19 all pass SELECT 1 health checks. This was already recorded during feature execution and is unrelated to the feature diff.
findings.reproduction: logs/working/qa-018/environment-startup-r3.log; run /usr/local/bin/prepare-test-environment.sh in a fresh lesovsky/pgcenter-testing:0.0.11 container.

findings.title: Existing debt [020]: malformed archive Ncols can still panic replay
findings.expected: Malformed untrusted archives produce a clean validation error.
findings.actual: The valid-layout replay boundary does not validate attacker-declared inconsistent Ncols/Cols dimensions. Whole-feature security review round 2 confirmed this unchanged existing debt.

findings.title: Existing debt [029]: server-controlled terminal cells remain unsanitized
findings.expected: Server/archive values cannot inject terminal controls.
findings.actual: The shared TUI cell printer still emits raw cell strings; autovacuum_scores relation is another recorded reachable surface. No shared sanitizer change belongs to this feature.
findings.reproduction: See docs/tech-debt.md [029] and the whole-feature security review round 2 data-flow evidence.

findings.title: Existing debt [035]: open-screen column widths can remain frozen
findings.expected: Long values appearing after the first frame are fully visible without manual widening.
findings.actual: The shared alignment behavior is unchanged; stats_age is explicitly included in this debt. Manual QA used the existing Up-arrow widening to inspect full relation names and did not treat the known behavior as a feature regression.
findings.reproduction: See docs/tech-debt.md [035]; enter a screen with NULL/short initial values and later render a longer value.

findings.title: Existing debt [037]: x/p cycles remain version-blind
findings.expected: Cycles skip screens unavailable on the connected PostgreSQL version.
findings.actual: statements_jit and progress_copy retain their pre-existing version-blind cycles. Only the new t group was made version-aware, as contracted.

gate3.reason: The skill permits the user acceptance gate only after passing QA. AC-32/TS-2 failed, so no acceptance request or Gate 3 sampling is presented.
